title: Judge Reviewer Concern Response
description: Structured response from the reviewer-concern judge call site (#2 per spec §6.9). When a reviewer returns verdict=concern, coach invokes this call site to decide whether to block (respawn the phase agent) or annotate-and-continue (proceed with a PR annotation queued for the COMPLETE phase). Spec: atdd-coach-spec-v9.md §6.9 call site #2.

decision.description: 'block' respawns the phase agent with reviewer findings + judge rationale embedded in spawn-feedback (per spec §7.6); 'annotate_and_continue' proceeds with pr_annotation queued for COMPLETE-phase PR-body inclusion (per spec §4.7).

rationale.description: Human-readable justification for why block or annotate-and-continue is the right call given the concern substance.

pr_annotation.description: Text to include in the COMPLETE-phase PR body when decision=annotate_and_continue. May be empty when decision=block (the annotation is unused).
